found_at: https://shopvox.com/ (header logo ; the site is behind Cloudflare's bot check, so the page was rendered and the file fetched in headless Chromium, work/agents/b28/scripts/fetch_via_browser.py; page saved as downloads/shopvox/src4/rendered.html)
edits: the logo is one compound path: kept the swirl mark's subpaths 0-7, dropped the 'shopVOX' letters (subpaths 8-17)
cropped the viewBox to the mark
recoloured the mark from the header's black to #1FB6FF, the blue shopVOX's own app logo SVG uses (app.shopvox.com sign-in page, downloads/shopvox/src3/inline/inline-00.svg)
notes: DECISION: colour. The marketing header SVG is black; shopVOX's app logo SVG draws the same mark in #1FB6FF and the favicons are blue (#3CA4DC site, #0086B9 app), so I recoloured the black to the app logo's #1FB6FF, which reads on both themes. If the reviewer prefers no recolour, ship the header's black mark for light and white for dark. The app's own #1FB6FF SVG could not be split with svgtool (its path packs arc flags, which the path parser rejects), so the geometry comes from the marketing header file.
license: shopVOX brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with shopVOX.
